About Me

Sarah (Narey) Yu

Sr. User Experience Designer at SAP Concur — Katy, Texas

Bio

I'm a Senior UX Designer with over 13 years of experience crafting user-centered digital products across enterprise software, travel technology, and real estate. I specialize in designing AI-powered tools and large-scale design systems that reduce friction for people doing complex, high-stakes work.

At SAP Concur, I lead UX for features used by millions of business travelers — from conversational AI trip management to executive assistant copilots undergoing live user testing with Fortune 500 companies.

I work closely with engineers and product managers to bridge the gap between design intent and technical implementation, with a strong focus on mobile-first, accessible, and system-consistent experiences.
